description: Header file declaring functions, types, and constants related to Multi-Link Devices (MLD) in a WLAN driver or management system.

methods.name: wld_apMld_areAllBssEnabled
methods.description: Checks if all BSSs (Basic Service Sets) within a specified MLD (Multi-Link Device) unit are enabled.

methods.name: wld_apMld_fetchAffiliatedStaInfo
methods.description: Fetches information about an affiliated station associated with a given MLD unit based on MAC address.

methods.name: wld_apMld_getActiveApAffiliatedStaInfo
methods.description: Retrieves active Access Point affiliated station information for a particular AP and MAC address.

methods.name: wld_apMld_notifyChange
methods.description: Notifies the system of a change event within the MLD, with a reason string.

methods.name: wld_apMld_getOrCreateDmObject
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a device management object for the specified MLD unit and type.

methods.name: wld_apMld_createAffiliatedAPObject
methods.description: Creates an object representing an affiliated Access Point within an MLD link.

methods.name: wld_apMld_deleteAffiliatedAPObjects
methods.description: Deletes all affiliated AP objects starting from a given link.

methods.name: wld_apMld_clearMld
methods.description: Clears or resets the MLD internal data structures.

methods.name: wld_apMld_getMldfromObj
methods.description: Retrieves the MLD structure from a given object.

methods.name: wld_apMld_updateAffAP
methods.description: Updates information about an affiliated Access Point within the MLD.

methods.name: wld_apMld_updateDM
methods.description: Updates the device management information for a given SSID.

methods.name: wld_apMld_hasSharedConnectionConf
methods.description: Checks whether two APMLD links share applicable SSID and security configurations.
